question: Do the directions of five exposed Treg RNAs transfer across the available, distinct EZH2 contexts?
decision: Identify direction concordance or discordance across specified contexts; do not nominate or validate targets.
strongest_rival: Differences in alleles, sorting, controls, culture and recovered states can produce discordance without a causal context interaction.
discriminator: Compare exact symbols across source-specific point estimates and retain available omission ranges; this cannot estimate a genotype-by-context interaction across sources.
exposure_record: Published results, Wang S1–S3 and existing Dp1/Peeters results including the five candidate directions are known. Exposed lookup of fixed panel; no target nomination.
biological_unit: Deposited RNA libraries summarized separately in three studies. Mouse/pool nesting not established across all sources.
nesting_and_overlap: Reuse of previously frozen library contrasts; no asserted biological independence or pooling across studies.
population_and_selection: Wang day-four activated CD62L-high starting mouse Tregs, DuPage mouse CD62L-high/low Tregs, and Peeters freshly sorted and day-four cultured mouse Tregs.
contrast: Wang fl/fl minus pooled or +/+ controls; DuPage CD62L-high and -low KO-minus-HET; Peeters fresh and day-four gain-minus-WT.
endpoint: Fixed panel of relative transcript-abundance directions within each source scale.
methods: Python 3.12.10 standard library exact case-sensitive unique Wang/DuPage symbol and Peeters contrast-key join. Preserve source estimates and existing sensitivity ranges, compare only directions.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new candidate or proxy. Stop if any fixed candidate or required contrast is absent or lacks unique eligible support.
multiplicity: Descriptive outputs only; no gene-level or set-level tests.
precision_basis: No sampling uncertainty is estimated for the finite deposited libraries.
interpretation_limit: No animal-population inference, cell-state or functional effect, tumor specificity or independent replication.
stop_rule: Do not add human tissue datasets or a new functional run absent a fit-for-purpose comparison. Do not pool magnitudes or estimate a cross-study interaction.
amendment_reason: S3 indicates distinct inflammatory and cell-cycle rank patterns. A fixed panel assesses whether RNA directions transfer across the previously examined contexts.
